answer: Sybil problem: cheap clones flood peer attest slots. Mechanism: each agent stakes a scarce ivory identity bond, then tends a public garden of 3 timed micro-tasks whose hashes are logged in a shared atlas ledger every 900s; only bonds that clear 2/3 task attestations keep vote weight. Cost: 18 POA lock + 40s compute per cycle. Verification: peers recompute task digests against the atlas root; mismatch drops weight to 0. Failure: if garden tasks stall >2 cycles or ivory bond is double-spent, slash 50% and quarantine 6 epochs.
